name: Client Proposal
description: Branded client-facing growth strategy proposal with cover page, approach, deliverables, timeline, and budget.

subtitle.description: Proposal subtitle shown on cover page (default: 'Growth Strategy Proposal')

date.description: Display date string on cover page; defaults to today

approach.description: Description of the proposed approach and methodology

deliverables.description: Array of deliverable objects: { item: string, timeline: string, notes?: string }

timeline_weeks.description: Engagement length in weeks for the timeline strip (default: 4)

budget.description: Array of budget line items: { line: string, amount: string }

total_budget.description: Total budget string displayed as the final row, e.g. "$12,000"
